name: HFusionFlattenOps
scope: The hfusion-flatten-ops pass itself: its function-eligibility gates, the greedy elementwise-collapse engine, the tidy dispatch into the analysis-driven Flattener, the pipeline placement sites in the regbase HFusion pipelines, and the observable behavior pinned by the FlattenOps test corpus. Excludes Flattener.cpp / DimensionAnalyzer internals (not read in this analysis) and the vectorization passes downstream.

why_this_subject: Phase T3 dogfood for the multi-pass system story: this pass is the shape-normalization step that hands 1-D-formed elementwise IR to the vector pipeline, so its guards and placements are the bridge between HFusion-level fusion and AutoVectorizeV2. It is also a well-bounded teaching subject: a 141-line pass file that dispatches to two very different engines (local greedy rewrite vs whole-function analysis), with a real test corpus pinning observable behavior.
